steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've arrived.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...What a depressing place.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Any mention of this on the news?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: None.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: By the looks of things, Ursus decided to abandon this place.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A deserted city, huh...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It this city has already become a Reunion stronghold, it's only going to cause more and more problems for Lungmen.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's too close to Lungmen.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But if Skullshatterer was taking commands from this place, we can't afford to ignore it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But... what exactly happened to this part of Chernobog?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's impossible for it to have moved this far after being hit by the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And why would it appear here?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: From the observation data we've gathered... this happened in the aftermath of the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Which means that this subsection was destroyed only after it reached here.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hah. Seems like Rhodes Island has some skilled Catastrophe Messengers.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's good to be cautious.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: We've been ambushed by poorly-organized thugs our entire way here...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Like vultures circling overhead, looking for carcasses among the ruins.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It makes my skin crawl.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I've confirmed the coordinates. We'll have to continue moving deeper--

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But judging from the terrain, we won't be able to move all our forces together.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Are we approaching the Originium-dense parts?

steps.name: Talulah
steps.text: (I didn't expect you to be here.)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, what do you think...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, where are you going?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Damn it, she just took off running! Who could that have been...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I didn't manage to get a good look either!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But that silhouette seemed like...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to follow her...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What bad timing...!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That guy is no ordinary henchman...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And... where did all of those Originium slugs crawl out from?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Those creatures... look like they might explode!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Make sure our operators exercise utmost caution!!
